about: The teacher's decisions on the questions Claude wrote for the Worksheet Maker bank. Saved by the Question review page on the staff Tools site (https://phillippain.github.io/Tools/question-review/); the Worksheet Maker reads this file when it opens. s: ok = approved, fix = needs a fix (see note; not used until fixed), out = removed (not used). h is the question's fingerprint when the decision was made: a question changed since then goes back on the review list.
